text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but taking gains on C, D, and E did not prevent the account from later losing value; a realized gain is not a guarantee of good overall performance.","Repeatedly selling Stock D after gains reduced my position, but I should make future trades based on risk and portfolio balance rather than the comfort of locking in profits.","With prices moving randomly, I should avoid treating recent rises or falls as signals and make decisions consistent with a diversified, long-term plan."]}
